messages:
dave_acme: Hey support — hitting a crash in our consumer when we use structured/json mode with streaming. We get a JSON parse error intermittently.

jess_support: sorry about that. Do you have the original response body or a minimal repro?

dave_acme: pasting snippet from our client logs — the stream sometimes yields this chunk boundary:
```
...{"id":123,"text":"Hello "world"
More text"}...
```
which obviously fails JSON.parse due to the unescaped inner quote. Happens ~1/200 requests. We're on api key <redacted> and using mode=structured&stream=true

jess_support: thanks — can you confirm SDK + client lib + platform? Also, any chance your prompt includes raw quotes/newlines? Could be chunk cut in middle of an escape.

dave_acme: client is node-fetch, node 18. Prompt includes user-supplied content that sometimes has quotes and emojis. We also tried with raw curl and see same failure when streaming. repro:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?mode=structured&stream=true" \
  -d '{"input":"say \"He said \"wow\"\" then newline"}'
```

ben_runtime: @jess_support can you grab the runtime logs for that customer ts? I suspect streaming chunk boundary is splitting a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence or leaving a trailing backslash before a quote.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-9876 created for support ticket #4532, priority P2.

carol_qa: I repro'd locally with a smaller model using the same streaming mode — when a JSON string contains an escaped sequence that ends right at a buffer boundary, the emitter didn't complete the escape, resulting in raw quote inside the chunk. Example observed:
```
chunk1: {"text":"This is a backslash: \\
chunk2: "and a quote"}
```
which concatenates to invalid JSON.

ben_runtime: nailed it — root cause is our streaming serializer using boundary-sized buffers and doing a naive split on bytes without ensuring escape sequences are atomic. When a backslash is last byte of a buffer and next chunk starts with a quote, consumer sees unescaped quote.

ben_runtime: short-term mitigation: set mode=structured and stream=false or have client buffer until a full JSON object is complete. Long-term: we'll push a fix to make the serializer ensure escapes are emitted atomically across chunks.

jess_support: @dave_acme for immediate workaround can you disable streaming or enable the SDK's full-body mode? We'll mark invoice/billing unaffected but understand this is blocking your parser.

dave_acme: disabling streaming fixes it for us, thanks. Please keep us posted on ETA — this is in our checkout flow so needs high priority.

ben_runtime: assigned to eng-runtime sprint, patch branch created (fix/stream-escape-atomic). Planned hotfix deploy in next patch window, ETA ~4 hours. I'll DM you when deployed. INC-9876 -> updated.

dave_acme: appreciated :thumbsup:

carol_qa: adding unit tests for multi-byte UTF-8 and escape-boundary cases. Also cross-checked billing logs — no double charging observed for retries.

jess_support: closing loop when patch is live. If you need a backported hotfix for dedicated instances, ping us.
